result.prior_version_note: Section 98.0704 was added by O-21647 N.S. (adopted 5-25-2023, effective 6-24-2023). It was then amended by O-21769 N.S. (adopted 2-27-2024, effective 3-28-2024). The documents do not say what the 2024 amendment changed in § 98.0704. Division 7 dates back to the 2004 'Tenants' Right to Know Regulations' (O-19269 N.S.). The documents do not describe what that earlier version required, so it is unknown whether a just-cause requirement existed before 2023.
